1. binding.rs: `BoardScope { world: String, backend, team, project: Option<String>, server: String, canonical_root: PathBuf }`, `resolve_board(dir) -> Result<BoardScope, BoardUnavailable>` (enum with human reason). 2. provider.rs: `#[async_trait] trait BoardProvider { async fn workflow_states(&self, scope) -> Result<Vec<WorkflowState{id,name,position}>, BoardError>; async fn issues(&self, scope) -> Result<Vec<BoardIssue{id,identifier,title,state_id}>, BoardError>; async fn issue_state(&self, scope, issue_id) -> Result<String, BoardError>; async fn set_issue_state(&self, scope, issue_id, state_id) -> Result<(), BoardError>; }` and `BoardError { Unauthorized(String), Unavailable(String), Provider(String), Uncertain(String) }`. Columns are in provider workflow-state order (sort by position then stable).
3. linear.rs: `LinearMcpProvider` over a narrow trait `McpCaller { async fn call(&self, server:&str, tool:&str, args: Value) -> anyhow::Result<String /* text */> }` (real impl wraps `crate::mcp::McpManager::call_tool`, `ContentBlock::Text`; tests use a fake). ALLOWLIST at this boundary: exactly tools `list_issue_statuses` ({team}), `list_issues` ({team, project?, limit, cursor?}, paginate with a hard page cap), `save_issue` ({id, state} ONLY: unit-test that the arg key set is exactly {id,state} and that no label/assignee/comment/description key can be produced). Never pass a tool name from outside. Scope enforcement: pass team/project ids from the binding; ALSO filter returned issues client-side so an issue whose team id (or project id when the binding has a project) is absent or different is dropped (fail closed; a connection that sees other teams like BrownandBrown must not leak). The real Linear MCP response shape is UNVERIFIED (no live calls allowed): write a tolerant JSON parser (array or object with `statuses`/`issues`/`nodes`; fields id/name/position or type, identifier, title, state{id,name} or status, team{id}/teamId, project{id}/projectId), test it against fixtures you invent and mark each fixture 'assumed shape' in a comment. Unparseable output => BoardError::Provider, never partial success. Map auth failures (401/unauthor/forbidden/not signed in text or error) to Unauthorized.
4. cache.rs: in-memory `BoardCache` keyed by `CacheKey { world, backend, auth_identity, team, project }` (auth_identity = `crate::mcp::tasks::server_identity(server_name,&McpServerConfig)` so it is secret-free), TTL, entries never returned for a different key, no fallback on error (an error does not serve another key's data; stale same-key data is NOT presented as current success: return it marked stale only if you add that, otherwise just drop). Tests for each key component isolation.
5. audit.rs: `AuditLog::open(path)` default path under the Jcode data dir (find the existing helper, e.g. jcode_dir/storage; use a file like board-audit.jsonl), created owner-only (0600, unix), opened O_APPEND, never truncated/rotated/deleted by this code (no API for it). `append(&AuditEvent) -> io::Result<()>` writes one JSON line + fsync-ish flush. Events: Intent{op_id, ts, world, backend, team, project, issue_id, expected_prior_state, requested_state, confirmation{confirmed_at}} and Outcome{op_id, ts, result: Applied|Conflict|Failed|Uncertain|Reconciled{applied: bool}}. NO credentials, no issue titles/content, ids and states only (test by serializing and asserting no extra text fields). Tests: append-only (earlier lines preserved byte-for-byte after later appends), 0600, failure injection (unwritable path) => error.
6. change.rs: `StatusChangeRequest { scope, issue_id, expected_prior_state, requested_state }`, `Confirmation` token bound to (issue, verified world, backend/team/project, expected prior, requested) — constructing it is the explicit user confirmation; `execute(req, confirmation, provider, audit, current_scope_fn) -> ChangeOutcome` order: (a) ADO => Err(ReadOnly) first, no audit, no provider; (b) confirmation must match req exactly else refuse; (c) re-resolve world NOW via `current_scope_fn` and require equality with the confirmed scope else WorldChanged, no provider contact; (d) read live state via provider.issue_state, if != expected_prior => Conflict (no write, append a Conflict outcome only if an intent was already written, otherwise no audit write needed); (e) append Intent (on error => AuditFailed, NO dispatch); (f) set_issue_state; Ok => append Applied; Err(Uncertain/transport) => append Uncertain and STOP: no automatic retry (Linear idempotency contract is unverified, say so in a doc comment); other Err => Failed. `reconcile(op, ...)` reads live state and appends Reconciled{applied}. Stable `op_id` generated once per confirmation. A pending operation stays attributed to its original scope.
